images.name: KP-1_a
images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Retry variant a. Image 1 is the edit target, a two-view pollaxe model sheet. Image 2 is the original weapon-design and watercolor-and-ink painting reference. Deliver ONE 1536x1024 PNG. CRITICAL CORRECTION: replace EVERY part of the dark background, brown haze and halo with perfectly uniform opaque bright GREEN, RGB (0,255,0), hex #00ff00, exactly as the background in Image 2. Green must reach every object contour; no dark vignette, halo, shadow, glow or residual haze anywhere. This flat green background is mandatory. Preserve the two vertical weapon views and their equal length with tips and butts aligned, full weapons visible. Left is the reference broadside, right is the identical weapon rotated 90 degrees about the haft with a thin edge-on axe blade. Keep the original reference's head shape, colour, ink line and washes, long pale haft with metal langets and small metal butt cap. Remove the extra diamond-decorated sleeve halfway down each shaft in Image 1: the original Image 2 has an uninterrupted straight shaft there. Show ONLY the two pollaxes, no knight, no hands, no gauntlets, no ground, no text, no labels, no extra objects. Copy the original painting hand: crisp dark sepia ink contours, hand hatching, uneven transparent watercolor washes, pale cream highlights, moderate warm stone-grey metal with small ochre accents. Soft even upper-left daylight, no dramatic lighting, no glossy highlights. The broadside and edge-on views must retain the same component heights and design. Entire surrounding canvas is solid pure #00ff00.
